source_family.spatial_graphs: The existing seven-link two-plaquette graph, and open cubic boxes with L>=2 vertices along each of three spatial directions; E=3L^2(L-1), P=3L(L-1)^2, girth four.
source_family.Hilbert: Gauge-invariant closed subspace of L2(SU(2)^E, normalized product Haar).
source_family.boundary: Open spatial boundary; gauge constraints at every vertex, no external charges.
source_family.core: Gauge-averaged smooth matrix-coefficient polynomials, closed in the physical form norm.
source_family.source_revision: Explicit Hamiltonian/anisotropic temporal heat-kernel regularization, not an assertion that the isotropic four-dimensional Wilson action family has already been constructed. Continuum equivalence remains open.

ground_state.existence: Compact elliptic Schrödinger theory and positivity-improving Feynman-Kac heat kernel give a unique smooth strictly positive normalized ground function Omega; gauge invariance follows by uniqueness.
ground_state.not_assumed: No prior positive mass-gap estimate is used to define or select Omega.
ground_state.unitary: Uf=Omega*f from L2(nu) to L2(mu); constant maps to the actual vacuum.
ground_state.detector: D_Omega psi=(Omega*X_ea(psi/Omega))_ea, with the same covariant Lie/edge target.
ground_state.form_identity: q_(H-E0)(psi)=kappa*||D_Omega psi||^2, first on the smooth core and then on the full physical form domain.

explicit_bound.heat_normalization: SU2 characters chi_n with link Casimir n(n+2)/4.
explicit_bound.chosen_parameter: kappa*t=8*log(2); t is a Euclidean semigroup/regulator parameter, not a derived physical clock.
explicit_bound.gap_bound: Delta>=3*kappa*(7/9)^(2E)*2^(-32*P*lambda/kappa)>0 for each fixed finite graph and finite lambda/kappa.
explicit_bound.volume_boundary: This particular lower bound tends to zero as open cubic volume grows, even at fixed coupling. It establishes no volume-uniform or continuum gap; the true gap need not tend to zero.

transfer.gauge_projection: P_G is normalized Haar averaging at every vertex.
transfer.symmetric_step: S_tau=P_G exp(-tau*V/2) exp(-tau*H0) exp(-tau*V/2) P_G, tau>0.
transfer.finite_state: Z_N=Tr_phys(S_tau^N)>0, N>=1; trace class follows from compact-group heat trace. Thermal cylinder expectations retain all link and gauge integrations.
transfer.reflection: For a suitable reflected even temporal cylinder, paired halves give Tr(A^*A)/Z>=0; positive square roots cover cut placement. This is temporal reflection positivity, not finite-cutoff Euclidean rotation covariance.
transfer.fixed_graph_time_refinement: Symmetric product formula converges strongly to exp(-T*H) at fixed graph as tau=T/N goes to zero. This is not spatial/continuum Yang-Mills reconstruction.

exact_control.kind: Three-site rational analogue, not an SU2 spectral truncation.

gate_scope: Constructs finite open-cubic SU2 Hamiltonian/heat-kernel transfer sources only. Does not close continuum correlation, reconstruction, or completion-stable separation.
